audit: Fresh independent I1 STATIC audit of frozen SPEC0209 reference-contract extractor
evidence_method: Complete inert source/test reading and manual code-path derivation; witnesses are embedded report data only. No reproduced runtime result is claimed.

findings.title: A plain ts runtime fence is absent from the physical-source payload index, so its mirrored contract type copies the guest source
findings.rule: Frozen C; complete physical-source role scope. A declaration-only literal stays exact under B, but this witness supplies identical literal bytes directly to Worker with eval:true in the same physical source.

inert_witness.text:
# Manual
## Mirror
```ts public-api
export type Mirror = "throw/STATIC_FENCE_R20/";
```
## Runtime
```ts
new Worker("throw/STATIC_FENCE_R20/", { eval: true });
```
inert_witness.setup: Conceptual override of this single allowlisted file in the sealed tests fixture, with its synthetic pin updated normally. Not created, parsed by the target, or executed during this audit.

code_path: isTypeScriptContractFence accepts ts public-api, but rejects plain ts (1319-1321). The prepass skips type-only Mirror as metadata. At the plain ts opening it indexes only the fence info string ts (1397-1405); on close it never indexes the Worker argument (1369-1383).
The projection emits the plain fence as document-unparsed (1561-1568,1628-1636). That UNKNOWN does not update payloadLiterals or taint Mirror.

extractTypeScriptContracts receives the incomplete shared map for the public-api fence. printed sees no collision for its literal, and prints the exact guest source (558-585). emitFor classifies this type entry STATIC because its shape has no UNKNOWN (1675).

other_entries: document-unparsed UNKNOWN: language carries digest/length of ts, not the guest source

findings.impact: Authenticated guest source reappears verbatim in the type representation despite a direct same-source executable-source use. Generic document UNKNOWN/parity NOT_VERIFIED do not satisfy per-representation opacity.
findings.expected: Keep all three entries, their owners and source provenance. Mirror type must carry UNKNOWN with payload digest/length/reason. Complete the local payload prepass for this concrete TS runtime context, without requiring universal languages, execution, name resolution or a code-generation analysis.
findings.test_gap: Physical-fence collision cases use ts public-api on both fragments; the unknown-fence test protects fence info, not runtime literals in its body. No sealed assertion covers this plain-ts/direct-Worker combination.

findings.title: Python __all__ copies an indexed runtime payload through an unchecked literal-valued export list
findings.rule: Frozen C and conservative same-source collision handling; all copied representations must be opaque for the identical executable-source literal. A clean export list remains exact under A/B.

inert_witness.text:
import subprocess
__all__ = ["debugger"]
def exported(value: "debugger") -> None:
    pass
subprocess.run(["node", "-e", "debugger"])
inert_witness.setup: Conceptual override in the sealed synthetic fixture, with its pin updated normally; no subprocess or Python is run by this audit.
inert_witness.role_evidence: The final subprocess.run argument list explicitly supplies debugger as node -e program source. This is not a spelling-only suspicion.

code_path: runtime_literals indexes debugger from subprocess.run; it separately skips the well-formed __all__ declaration as metadata (1009-1020).
typ consults payload_literals, so exported parameter annotation becomes UNKNOWN (1047-1050).
The __all__ row branch accepts any bounded identifier string list via ast.literal_eval and copies names:value without consulting payload_literals (1074-1079).

collectReferenceCatalog sends that row through emitFor unchanged; projectIdentity applies only to symbol __all__, not shape.names. hasUnknown finds none in names, so python-exports is STATIC (1657-1675,1797-1799).

parameter_type.reason: Unresolved Python annotation/runtime payload collision; bytes not copied

findings.impact: The same digest is protected in the annotation but leaks as raw program-source text in an independently classified STATIC export-data entry. The validator and freeze hashing authenticate the leaked shape; they do not enforce role opacity.
findings.expected: Retain python-exports, __all__ identity, all names/requirements, source and owner; project colliding list elements to UNKNOWN with digest/length/reason, preserving noncolliding genuine exports.
findings.test_gap: The positive __all__ test places runtime collision evidence in another physical file. The opaque __all__ test uses a non-identifier function body, which takes the existing regex-rejection path. Neither covers a legitimate identifier-shaped export-list element colliding with a real same-source node -e payload.

findings.title: An annotated literal __all__ declaration has no python-exports requirement
findings.rule: SPEC0209 static Python/export contract collection and declaration/requirement retention. No dynamic export or whole-program resolver is needed for a literal annotated assignment.

inert_witness.setup: Conceptual synthetic fixture override only; no fixture/Python/helper execution.

code_path: runtime_literals.export_metadata explicitly recognizes ast.AnnAssign __all__ with a literal identifier list and skips it as declaration metadata (1011-1018).
The row extractor handles top-level functions, classes, ImportFrom and ast.Assign __all__, but has no top-level AnnAssign branch (1066-1079).

The source still gets python-surface, Client and Client.send; the __all__ export-list declaration itself is never emitted. A generic source UNKNOWN does not preserve the missing named export-list requirement.

derived_output.unannotated_control: Replacing the first line with __all__ = ["Client"] emits the additional python-exports row with shape.names=["Client"].

findings.impact: A directly declared static Python export surface disappears from the catalog denominator solely because it has a type annotation. The comparator cannot reject a requirement that collection never represented; this is not a claim of removal from a supplied historical freeze.
findings.expected: Emit the annotated literal __all__ declaration using the same stable kind/symbol/owner/source and collision-aware value handling as the unannotated form. Retain the surrounding entries.
findings.test_gap: Sealed __all__ positives are unannotated assignments; no top-level annotated literal __all__ control is present.
